clue.text: How Walrus feasted to capacity after first-rate preparation

indicators.note: after says the phrase for 'to capacity' comes behind the rest

parts.note: tea is a preparation, a brewed infusion made up from leaves

indicators.note: first, joined to rate, asks for only the opening letter of that word

parts.note: filled to capacity means filled fully

explanation.surface: A gluttonous walrus eats until full after a top-class meal has been laid on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first-rate' looks like praise for the preparation, but it splits: 'first' takes R from 'rate'. The Walrus in Lewis Carroll's poem weeps as he eats the oysters.
explanation.definitionFit: In Carroll's 'The Walrus and the Carpenter' the Walrus sobs while devouring the oysters, so he dines weeping.

clue.text: Draw encouragement from fellow entering abstract paintings

parts.note: to abstract is to remove or take
he stands for any male, a fellow
art means paintings collectively

explanation.surface: A man going into an exhibition of abstract art feels heartened.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abstract' looks like a style of painting, but it is the verb meaning remove.
explanation.definitionFit: To take courage is to gain confidence or comfort from something.

clue.text: Record set by girl on lake

indicators.note: on in a down clue means the girl's name sits above the next letter

parts.note: Anna is a girl's name
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A girl sets a record on a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: An annal is a yearly record of events.

clue.text: Steady support provided for tree requiring emergency treatment

indicators.note: in a down entry the steady word goes underneath, supporting the tree word

parts.note: a fir is a conifer
staid means steady, sober

explanation.surface: A tree needs a firm prop to recover after damage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'support provided for' says STAID is placed under FIR in the column.
explanation.definitionFit: First aid is the immediate care given to the injured before a doctor arrives.

clue.text: Showed way to capture venomous creature having a run

indicators.note: to capture means the word for showed way closes around the snake

parts.note: to lead is to show the way; its past is led
an adder is Britain's venomous snake

explanation.surface: Someone guided a hunt for a venomous creature that was on the run.
explanation.walkthrough: A run in stockings is a ladder, so laddered tights have runs.
explanation.definitionFit: A stocking with a ladder has a vertical line of unravelled stitches, the British term for a run.

clue.text: Old freeholders producing nothing in eastern country

indicators.note: in says the zero letter is placed inside the country

parts.note: Yemen is a Middle Eastern country
O is the figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Old landowners yield nothing in a country of the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Yeomen were farmers who owned and worked their own small estates in old England.

clue.text: Examination by head of conchology of marine growth

indicators.note: head of points to the opening letter of the word conchology

parts.note: an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A test set by the head of shell studies on something that grows in the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: This hard reef-building substance is formed by colonies of tiny sea creatures.

clue.text: Indian parley extremely menacing

parts.note: the Cree are a Native American people

indicators.note: extremely asks for the letters at the extremes of parley

explanation.surface: Peace talks with a Native American tribe are extremely threatening.
explanation.definitionFit: Creepy means frightening, causing unease.

clue.text: Apologetic agent finds new tenant

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative, an agent

indicators.note: new asks for a fresh arrangement of the letters of tenant

explanation.surface: A sorry estate agent finds a new lodger.
explanation.definitionFit: Repentant means sorry, contrite for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Instrumentalist without the lead in rock band, say

indicators.note: without the lead says the instrumentalist word drops its first letter

parts.note: a player is a musician on an instrument

explanation.surface: A musician missing from the front line of a rock group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rock band' suggests pop music; here it is a stratum in rock.
explanation.definitionFit: A stratum in rock forms a band of one material lying between others.

clue.text: Thoughtful revolutionary family

parts.note: a thoughtful person is kind, considerate
a Red is a revolutionary communist

explanation.surface: A caring family of radicals.
explanation.definitionFit: Kindred means one's relations, the people of one's blood.

clue.text: Go too far in settling the score?

definitions.text: Go too far in settling the score?

parts.words: Go too far in settling the score?
parts.note: the score seems to be a grudge being avenged, but it is a bill being paid with more money than it asks

explanation.surface: Someone taking revenge overdoes it.
explanation.definitionFit: To hand over more than a bill demands is to exceed the sum due when settling an account.

clue.text: Composer's short vacation before opening of "Turandot"

indicators.note: before places the vacation word ahead of the next letter

parts.note: hols is the shortened British word for holidays

indicators.note: opening of takes just the starting letter of the opera title Turandot

explanation.surface: A composer takes a brief holiday before the premiere of Puccini's opera.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', a link. Gustav Holst wrote The Planets; Turandot is by Puccini, a red herring.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustav Holst was the English composer of The Planets suite.

clue.text: Chanticleer, perhaps, springs a surprise

definitions.meaning: Chanticleer is the cockerel of fable, whose crowing at dawn makes sleepers wake and look
something that springs a surprise is a revelation that startles

explanation.surface: The farmyard cock unexpectedly does something startling.
explanation.definitionFit: A rooster wakes people at daybreak, and a startling revelation is likewise something that makes one stare.

clue.text: Diagnose disorder when pain suffered

indicators.note: disorder tells us the letters of diagnose are thrown into confusion

explanation.surface: A doctor identifies an illness when the patient is in pain.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in torment is to have endured great pain or anguish.

clue.text: Giving attention to former pupil needing help

parts.note: OB is an old boy, a former pupil of a school
a help is a domestic servant

explanation.surface: An old schoolboy who needs assistance is watchful.
explanation.definitionFit: An observant person notices things, being alert and attentive.

clue.text: Carry on with the instrument

definitions.meaning: to keep talking tediously about something
a large stringed instrument plucked with the fingers

explanation.surface: Keep playing the instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: To harp on is to nag repeatedly; it is also the many-stringed instrument of angels and Welsh bards.

clue.text: Workers found cutting capers on Nelson's column

indicators.note: found cutting means the run of letters is discovered slicing across these words

explanation.surface: Labourers are seen frolicking on the London monument.
explanation.walkthrough: NELSON'S COLUMN is a monument in Trafalgar Square, London.
explanation.definitionFit: Personnel are the staff of an organisation.

clue.text: Upset woman's call for deed of separation

indicators.note: upset in a down entry turns the woman's word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: Eve's, the first woman's
to ring is to telephone, call

explanation.surface: A distressed woman telephones about a legal separation document.
explanation.definitionFit: Severing is the act of cutting off or parting.

clue.text: Water defences to counter storms

parts.note: a bar is a counter where drinks are served
to rage is to storm

explanation.surface: Sea walls built to resist storms.
explanation.definitionFit: Barrages are dams built across rivers to control water.

clue.text: Tax judgment

definitions.meaning: to tax is to strain or try someone's powers
a trial or examination by which something is judged

explanation.surface: A ruling about tax.
explanation.definitionFit: Taxing someone's patience tries it; an examination is a means of assessment.

clue.text: One gone with the wind

parts.note: the phrase recalls the film title but names both a strong easterly of the Mediterranean and someone who absconds without paying

explanation.surface: A nod to the film Gone with the Wind.
explanation.definitionFit: This word is a gusty easterly Mediterranean wind, and also a person who bolts leaving bets or debts unpaid.

clue.text: His courtyard holds 12

indicators.note: holds means the courtyard word contains another letter

parts.note: a garth is an enclosed cloister courtyard
12 across is the opener of an eye, its first letter

explanation.surface: A man's courtyard has room for a dozen.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference means the clue at 12, read as 'eye opener', the first letter of EYE.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's name, so 'His' stands for this Welsh name, also a Round Table knight.

clue.text: Microscopic life offering growing help to millions

indicators.note: growing in a down entry means rising upwards, so the help word reads from the bottom

parts.note: aid is help
M is short for million

explanation.surface: Something offering help to grow crops for millions.
explanation.definitionFit: Diatoms are single-celled algae with silica walls.

clue.text: Mineral extracted from spoil that's cast out

parts.note: to mar something is to spoil it

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of cast and the abbreviation are jumbled

parts.note: i.e. is short for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A mineral is dug from mining waste that has been thrown away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' turns IE plus CAST into CASITE. 'Spoil' looks like mining waste but is the verb MAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Marcasite is a pale iron sulphide, used in cheap jewellery.

clue.text: Eat a lot about noon

indicators.note: about means the word for a lot goes round the other letter

parts.note: much means a lot

explanation.surface: Eating a big lunch at midday.
explanation.definitionFit: To munch is to eat with steady chewing.

clue.text: Churchman endlessly making the front page

indicators.note: endlessly says the churchman word loses its final letter

parts.note: a rector is a parish clergyman

explanation.surface: A clergyman somehow gets onto the newspaper's front page.
explanation.definitionFit: In printing, the right-hand page of an open book, the front of a leaf, is so called.

clue.text: Uplift obtained from church music

parts.note: an air is a tune, music

explanation.surface: Spiritual elevation from hymns.
explanation.definitionFit: To chair someone is to carry them shoulder-high in triumph, lifting them up.

clue.text: Least generous of intimates?

definitions.meaning: near means mean or stingy, so the superlative is the meanest
one's ... and dearest are close family and friends

explanation.surface: Who is the stingiest among one's close friends?
explanation.definitionFit: Near is old slang for stingy, so its superlative is the stingiest; one's closest relations are one's nearest and dearest.

clue.text: Popular cereal — plant deeply

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
grain is the seed of cereal crops

explanation.surface: A fashionable cereal crop is sown deep.
explanation.definitionFit: To fix a habit or idea firmly is to embed it so it becomes part of the fibre.

clue.text: Couple seek a lift

definitions.meaning: to couple is to hook or fasten together, as a trailer to a car

explanation.surface: Two people try to thumb a ride.
explanation.definitionFit: To couple a trailer is to fasten it on; thumbing a ride is hitchhiking.

clue.text: Publication is to introduce alternative art by a student of the masters

indicators.note: to introduce says the words before lead in to what follows

parts.note: a mag is a magazine, a publication

indicators.note: alternative asks for another arrangement of the letters of art

parts.note: L is a learner, a student driver

explanation.surface: A magazine plans to bring in alternative art made by an apprentice to old masters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alternative' rearranges ART as TRA. 'by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Magistral means relating to a master, authoritative or masterly.
